name: comp-589
blurb: Breadcrumb header with double-dropdown for account/project selection.
description: Header with breadcrumb showing account and project dropdowns. Secondary nav menu below (desktop only). Notifications and user menus included.
use_when: Multi-tenant apps where users manage multiple accounts or projects and need quick switching.
avoid_when: Single-account or flat hierarchy; breadcrumbs and dropdowns add cognitive load.
a11y: Breadcrumb navigable. Dropdowns keyboard-accessible with aria-label. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded.
